source: Code Odyssey 5.0 organiser datasets (datasets/datasets/*.zip). Extracted to datasets/raw/ with trailing spaces stripped from path components and "Telegu" folders renamed "telugu". The zips are untouched.
privacy: pdfs/hindi/* are scans of real applicants' handwritten business plans with real names, phone numbers and email addresses. Treat them as personal data: keep the repository private, never push them to a public remote, and never show them unredacted in a public demo.

canonicalFields.location: Where will you set up the business? (village, block, district, PIN)
canonicalFields.offering: Which products or services will you provide?
canonicalFields.customers: Who are your target customers? (age, gender, segment)
canonicalFields.market_research: Have you done market research in your target market? Details.
canonicalFields.raw_materials: What raw materials will you need?
canonicalFields.funding: Which avenues will you use to raise funds, and why would they lend to you?
canonicalFields.competition: Is there competition for your business? Details.
canonicalFields.unit_price: What is the price per unit of your main product or service?
canonicalFields.monthly_revenue: How much do you expect to earn every month?

templates.edp-idea-brief: Tata STRIVE EDP "Business Idea Brief": name, mobile, interested business, 10 canonical questions in English. 2 pages.
templates.edp-business-plan: Tata STRIVE EDP "Business Plan" in Hindi, handwritten on paper and scanned: profile, product/service, customers, competitors, resources, location, 3-phase financial model (A-N formulas), promotion plan, annexures A-C (cash books). 11 pages.
templates.platform-form-en: Application platform export (ReportLab): profile incl. category, business type, domain, investment / self / loan; customer gender, age and segment; market type; existing business.
templates.platform-form-hi: Application platform export (program "Nanounicorn for testing", downloaded 14 Oct 2026) with Hindi prompts and "[Left Blank]" / "[Not Answered]" markers.
templates.platform-form-hi-v2: Alternate one-page layout of the Hindi platform form ("Business Idea Submission").
templates.platform-form-te: Telugu variant of the platform export.
templates.edp-form-mr: Marathi form: profile incl. social category (OBC/SC/NT/General) and the 10 questions in Marathi.
templates.edp-form-mr-custom: Marathi form with 10 sector-specific technical questions replacing the standard ones.
templates.case-study-paper-te: Telugu case-study evaluation paper (sections A and B); not an applicant form.

groups.parityGroup: Same idea in different languages or formats; scores should agree within 5 points.
groups.duplicateGroup: Same applicant and same idea submitted more than once.
groups.clusterGroup: Different applicants with similar ideas in the same area.
groups.contactGroup: Files sharing a phone number. C0-placeholder is a dummy contact (9000000080 / student80@demo.com). Groups C2 and C3 span different people and ideas, so a contact match alone must never merge records.
